name: semantic-mtg
description: Semantic MTG — linked data for Magic: The Gathering cards. SMTG-O (Semantic MTG Ontology): an identity-aware, provenance-rich ontology, its vocabularies, validation and documentation. Unofficial fan/research project, not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast.

scripts.audit:census: node tools/audit/census-scryfall.mjs && node tools/audit/profile-tagger.mjs && node tools/audit/profile-spellbook.mjs
scripts.build: npm run vocab && npm run map:fixtures && npm run map:coverage && npm run validate && npm run cq && npm run docs:build
scripts.build:docs-only: npm run map:coverage && npm run validate && npm run cq && npm run docs:build
